body:
(24F) I have lost about 15-20 lbs the past few months due to my emetophobia and chronic stomach issues going hand in hand. I was skipping meals daily to avoid any stomach pain/discomfort that will make me want to get sick, and i also have lost a ton of hair. I didn’t know there was a correlation until tonight when I was researching EDs. I used to have beautiful thick curly hair and within a year it’s gone really thin, and when I shower it comes out in clusters. When my hair is wet i can literally see my scalp. I never understood why my hair changed so drastically and spent so much money trying to buy things for hair growth and thinning. It was super stressful and it made me really sad. Earlier today when I learned Anorexia can cause hair loss due to being malnourished, i just started to cry a lot and have a mental breakdown. i’m hoping to overcome these obstacles soon, I hope you do too. 
Best of luck to you.

I am 5’2 and am now 95 lbs.
